_note: Every rate here is an assumption you own. Duty rates change with each Union Budget and freight changes with every quote — check them against your own customs broker and courier before pricing anything you will actually sell. npm run cost shows what each one does to the price.

import._hs: 7117 — imitation jewellery. Confirm the heading with your broker; a different heading is a different duty.

returns._note: RTO plus customer returns. Fashion jewellery sold D2C in India commonly sees 15-25% on prepaid and far worse on COD — set this from your own data as soon as you have any.

pricing._note: Margin is a share of revenue net of GST, not a multiplier on cost.
pricing._floorNote: The lowest margin a discount may take a piece to. Not a hard block - the admin page warns and lets you decide, because a loss-leader is sometimes deliberate. Set it from what your own fixed costs need.
